meta.format: rows[]: {fn, case?, in:{name:decimal string}, out:{name:decimal string}} or {fn, case?, in, revert:code}. All numbers are decimal strings of unsigned 256-bit integers. revert codes: overflow (Solidity panic 0x11, arithmetic overflow or underflow, Rust must use checked ops and fail), div_zero (panic 0x12), bad_seed (launch_seed custom error BadSeed when tokens == 0). The function names are the Rust engine names. Composite rows (quote_buy, quote_sell, launch_seed, split_loss) mirror the exact sequence used in Arena.sol: buy 367-370, sell 389-391, launch 293-297, merger split 680-707 (split_loss is the treasury-remainder arithmetic with 3 bps inputs). Solidity state is uint128 in Arena; values above 2^128 exist only to prove 256-bit intermediates.
